newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 30.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The Finance Ministry says it will make risk control the key task for the state debt market in 1997.
- Banks and financial institutions are poised for the issue of a new batch of 40 billion yuan worth of state debt starting on Thursday.

- BUSINESS NEWS - China issues a set of rules governing individuals taking out mortagages on homes, saying the longest period for such a morgagae will be 20 years and the loan must not exceed 70 percent of the total of a home's value.
- Shanghai has resettled 80,000 families who have housing problems with a per capita living space of less than four square metres in the past 10 years.
